style: Title screen key art for Boogle, a goofy low-poly multiplayer island game. Stay honest to how the game looks today (the reference image is a screenshot): flat-shaded low-poly terrain, bright green grass hills, warm tan sand, chunky low-poly palm trees with curved trunks, grey-brown boulders, a red-and-white striped lighthouse with a spiral stair on the hill, a pale lavender-blue sky. The players are smooth, glossy capsule shapes (tall rounded pills) in single solid colours (blue, orange, green, pink, yellow) with no faces, no arms, no legs and no clothes. The Boogler is a low, flat, squashed purple blob like a puddle of jelly with a tall black top hat on top, no face. The beach ball is white with red and blue panels. Only lightly stylized: a little more painterly light, richer colour and a soft vignette than the screenshot, but the same shapes. Composition: the beach ball big and mid-bounce in the foreground with a puff of sand, two or three capsule players hopping after it, The Boogler nearby, the lighthouse hill behind. The upper third is open calm sky with nothing in it, the bottom fifth is plain calm sand with nothing on it, and the subject stays near the horizontal centre so a tall phone crop still works. 16:9.

items.prompt: Warm late-afternoon golden light, long soft shadows on the sand, the lighthouse catching the sun. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI.
